line: These niggas broke, I heard these niggas shoppin’ J.C. Penney
vault_lines: These niggas broke, I heard these niggas shoppin' J.C. Penney (21, 21)
meaning: J.C. Penney is known for selling name brands at a cheaper price and 21 is saying that his competition is broke and can only afford discount prices.

line: Bitch I shoot like I’m Cupid
vault_lines: Choppa on me, bitch I shoot like I'm Cupid
meaning: 21 is saying that he doesn’t miss when he shoots and that his shots are on purpose, just like Cupid’s (the angel of love).
